name: Gurgos Ironchain
bio: If Furnos is the Magmabloods' immovable object, Gurgos is its unstoppable force. He's never seen with his prized weapon, Ol' Thumpy – a giant metal ballast torn from the black iron drawbridge of Felheim, the home base of the Magmabloods. Do not touch Ol' Thumpy without Gurgos' permission. He's very precious about it.
